At startRef 07f0512 it prints `CR 2384 CRLF 2384 LONE_CR 0` and `INSERTIONS 0 ADDED_LINES 0`.

C1-3 (no other byte changed). TAC on 05 prints `REPL R1 NEW 1 OLD 0`, `REPL R2 NEW 1 OLD 0` and `BASE_MATCH yes`: with every block removed and every replacement reverted the sha256 is 99ac05a316cf5007e69d068bf73d4a72ad58e0371db960da2fca0f5759e807c0, the startRef digest, so with C1-2 the change is the blocks and the listed replacements and nothing else (C1 U1, section 2.2). At startRef TAC prints `REPL R1 NEW 0 OLD 1` and `REPL R2 NEW 0 OLD 1`.

C1-4 (bold parity).
